caption: The drawing consists of three vertical border designs arranged side by side on a plain, cream-colored background. The design on the left features repeating diamond and flower-like shapes, all in a reddish-brown color, arranged in a straight vertical line. The middle design depicts a brown curving stem with symmetrical, serrated leaves branching out on either side at intervals from top to bottom. The rightmost design shows a pattern of alternating geometric shapes, such as concentric circles and diamond shapes, enclosed within two parallel dotted lines, also in a reddish-brown hue. At the bottom of the page, the words "BORDER DESIGNS" are printed in bold, uppercase black letters.
title: Border Designs from Proposed Portfolio "Maine Wall Stencils"
